description: Fixed arithmetic mean of seeds 42/43/44 of the point4 + spectral e2000fs_calib_offset_roll recipe (A900: original features minus suvi_t035_equatorial_area and strip_v650_dark, plus v_lag24/48/72; 900 rounds per 24-lead block; prior model + frozen per-lead offset alpha 0.25 over the last 336 training calibration origins), each booster then continued with 180 trees (6 stages x 30) on the training-sample competition score S = mean_h (MSE_h TIMSE_h)^(1/4) plus the same 0.1 robust Fourier term, S coefficients refreshed each round, every stage accepted by an exact Armijo line search restricted to steps that keep each lead's raw training MSE <= 1.01 x A900; offsets refit from the continued prior models. Equal 1/3 weights; no fitted weights, no labels. Official F1/F2/F3, 144h maturity. Does not pass the preregistered 1 % gate; published on user request.

hyperparameters.calibration: prior model on the reference window + frozen per-lead offset = 0.25 x mean residual of the last 336 calibration origins (training data only), clip [1, 3000] before and after
hyperparameters.objective: A900: point4 tail-weighted squared error + 0.1 x pseudo-Huber Fourier term; continuation: training-sample S + same Fourier term, raw training MSE cap 1.01 x A900 per lead
hyperparameters.parent: e2000fs_calib_offset_roll point4 + spectral recipe (A900, git e6dde5e1a)
